chennaimoms website
, there i found many friends and i got many guidelines.You also check it out it may help you and fun..
Normal signs of pregnancy
Food cravings.
Sensitive and Swollen Breasts
Frequent urination
Constipation
Bloating of abdomen
Raised basal body temperature
Uncommon pregnancy signs
Fatigue
Faintness and dizzines
Mood swings

Hello all,
I have recently found out that i am pregnant i noticed that i was spotting and got really worried so went to the doctor and he sent me to EPU where i have a couple of blood tests and a scan. They couldnt really see alot in the scan as they think i am only around 4 weeks pregnant all they could see was a little sac but nothing else.
They asked if i could co in for more blood tests so they can test my hormone levels and compare them with my last blood test! we were waiting very patientley for the results and unfotunatley it wasnt the news we were hoping for.
The midwife said my hormone levels have gone up a little but not as much as they should be at this stage, and i am also showing signs of a failing or an ectopic pregnancy!:(
I am now booked in for another scan on Monday to find out exactlry what is going on!
Has anyone else had anything similar to this should we be preparing our selves for the worse? i have never felt so upset and scared in my whole life and we are really hoping that this is a scare and everything is ok but i really am so unsure on what to do or think:(
xx
